Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Portable unweighted binary64 central M3/M4 composed with existing ordinary Moments. Explicit population skewness/Pearson and excess kurtosis and adjusted Fisher–Pearson skewness/excess kurtosis; updates and borrowed batches publish all orders atomically, including higher-specific Underflow when nonconstant M4 rounds nonpositive. Both registered runtime tests pass on Linux x86_64 in 9.54 seconds: 1,212 exact-input Fraction/Decimal cases across 51 datasets/eight modes/two descending f64 backing forms, plus atomic/count/view/Underflow contracts with zero mapping calls. An initial positive-stride assertion was corrected in the fixture to the documented descriptor, without a compiler change. The real CSV application passes four registered tests/66 cases against current dependencies. No allocation or host math; finite numerical limits, manual backing lifetimes, positive-subnormal accuracy limits and unclaimed other targets/formal proofs remain explicit.
